descriptor: Brand design agency launching memorable identities

voice.summary: A punchy creative director: loud on headline, precise on detail. Big short words, uppercase energy and a clear track record.
dos: Use big, short verbs such as build, launch and resonate
Back claims with a number, such as 50+ brands
Keep body copy to a single line

boilerplate: Brandly is a brand design agency with more than five years of experience and over 50 launched brands, creating thoughtful identities that captivate and empower.

microcopy.success: Message sent. We'll be in touch

logo.note: A single spark expresses an agency's creative ignition and a brand being born.
